_doc: B4-shape tool selection: 'create an RDP' unambiguously picks create-rdp. Tool is gated (tools.yaml description requires explicit user confirmation before invoking) so the agent must NOT call on turn 1. Turn 2 'no': SEMPv2 GET on the target RDP name returns 404. Name is intentionally out-of-suite ('e2e-llm-nope-rdp') so a stray create is easy to spot. Mirrors b4-select-create-vpn / b4-select-create-topic-endpoint.
prompt: Create a new REST Delivery Point named e2e-llm-nope-rdp in VPN $BROKER_VPN on $BROKER.
